commentary: With the Nifty falling 0.44% to 22,622.70 amid 13 consecutive sessions of FPI net selling and surging crude ($106–$107), breadth has degraded to a weak 37. Stan Weinstein’s discipline dictates defensive posture during broad index pullbacks, as distribution pressures undercut breakout follow-through. Jesse Livermore and William O'Neil cautioned that leading setups must show uncompromised relative strength and top-tier CANSLIM earnings acceleration while the market corrects. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules govern: with the general market gate at WEAK, cash remains the default posture. Only high-conviction Stage 2 candidates displaying genuine volume absorption and verified 25%+ earnings growth deserve monitoring, while non-earning and unconfirmed breakouts must be avoided entirely.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: SEPA (Minervini), CANSLIM (O'Neil), Stage Analysis (Weinstein), Livermore Tape Discipline

21STCENMGM.technical: Clearing 20-session resistance on 3.89x volume above moving averages suggests base emergence, but deep prior markdown leaves heavy overhead supply and questionable relative strength.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Microcap financial holding entity afflicted by negative EPS (-₹16.41 LTM) and operational losses. Erratic revenue and total absence of institutional backing violate CANSLIM criteria.
21STCENMGM.risk: A breakdown below the 43.53 stop triggers immediate exit; lack of earnings support leaves it vulnerable to sharp downside.

ADVANCE.technical: High-volume 20-session breakout supported by 11.4x 20-day volume. Positioned cleanly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 70 showing strong relative price leadership.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Agrochemical manufacturer demonstrating robust CANSLIM traits with net profit up 152% and revenue surging 96%. Healthy 19.6% ROCE and 17.2% ROE confirm underlying fundamental strength.
ADVANCE.risk: A breach of the 128.51 stop signals a false breakout in a hostile market, demanding immediate loss cutting.

AEGISLOG.technical: Textbook institutional double bottom pattern above rising 21, 50, and 200 moving averages. Reclaimed 21-day EMA with expanding MACD, confirming orderly supply absorption near highs.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Premier liquid and LPG logistics operator delivering standout 269% EPS growth and 37% revenue gains. Major terminal expansions across six ports provide sustainable multi-year institutional sponsorship.
AEGISLOG.risk: A decline below the 1383.96 swing low violates the double bottom structure and mandates an automatic stop-out.

AEROENTER.technical: Double bottom pattern pressing neckline resistance on 5.55x volume surge. Favorable moving average stack (Price > EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200) and RSI 65 confirm active Stage 2 accumulation.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Parent to Aeroflex Industries; quarterly profit surged over 600% on 135% revenue growth. Low debt-to-equity (0.04) and 15.9% ROCE confirm balance-sheet health, though non-operating income requires monitoring.
AEROENTER.risk: A close below the 146.68 pivot invalidates the base pattern and requires strict risk discipline.

AEROFLEX.technical: Tight consolidation within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot. Massive 9.3x average volume and RSI at 63 above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 indicate institutional accumulation.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Manufacturer of metallic flow solutions posting 162% profit growth and 72% sales acceleration. Clean balance sheet (debt/equity 0.02) and 18.9% ROCE meet O'Neil's growth profile.
AEROFLEX.risk: Failure to hold the 522.61 stop indicates breakout exhaustion and enforces an immediate capital-preservation exit.

AETHER.technical: Double bottom formation consolidating above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Testing neckline with RSI at 64 and positive MACD indicates constructive base building.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemicals producer benefiting from rising CRAMS and exclusive synthesis contracts. Q1 PAT jumped 33% on 27% sales growth, though ROCE at 11.9% remains moderate.
AETHER.risk: A drop below the 1676.19 swing stop breaks base symmetry and triggers defensive liquidation.
